title: CI, Delivery and Observability
introduction: Automated pipelines produce repeatable evidence, while observability explains how the delivered system behaves.
learningOutcomes: Use logs, metrics and traces for different questions.

activities.question: Order a basic delivery pipeline.
activities.explanation: A reviewed change is checked, built once and then the verified artifact is deployed.

activities.question: Which signal best shows request latency over time?
activities.explanation: Metrics aggregate numeric behaviour such as rates, durations and resource use.

activities.question: Deploying code and exposing it to every user must always happen at the same instant.
activities.explanation: Feature flags and staged release can separate deployment from user exposure.
